entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you with the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana. I'm calling about a ClubFit Jersey I bought a little while ago. I'd like to start a return.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, can I have your name and order number?
Sure, the name is Alex Chen, and the order number is VF881-90210. I'll be honest, it was delivered a couple of months back.
Thank you, Alex. I see the order. Just so I can document this correctly, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a preference, I suppose. I finally tried it on for a ride yesterday, and it's the wrong size. It's just too tight across the chest. I was hoping to exchange it for the next size up.
I understand completely. Getting the right fit is crucial. Let me pull up your delivery date... okay, I see it arrived 81 days ago. Let me just confirm our policy.
Okay, thanks for your patience. Our policy states that you can return items within 90 days of delivery, so you're still within the window. We can absolutely process that for you.

That's great news, thank you. Now, since I'm a long-time customer and I'll need to re-order the jersey in the correct size, would it be possible to get a small discount code for the new purchase? It would save me the shipping fee and ensure I get the replacement right away.

That's a reasonable request. I see here that you are a VIP member with us, and we definitely want to make sure you get the right gear. For the inconvenience of having to place a new order, I can add a 20% discount coupon to your account, effective immediately. How does that sound?
A 20% discount is fantastic. That works perfectly. So you'll send me a return label for the original jersey, and I can use the code for the new one?

Exactly. I'm sending you an email right now with the pre-paid return label and a confirmation of the discount code on your account. Just send back the jersey that's too tight, and you can place the new order whenever you're ready. Your refund will be processed as soon as we receive the original item.
Perfect. That's excellent service. Thank you for making that so easy, Diana.
You're very welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great ride.
